annotations.title: Copy an image into another set

description: Copies a finished image into another image set of the same product, platform and language (for example to build variant B of an A/B test), as that set’s picked version of the image. Free: the same file. Example: {"generation_id": "…", "image_set_id": "…"}
name: copy_image_to_set
title: Copy an image into another set
